labeler: self (Claude Code review against InsecureBankv2 README + OWASP MASTG canonical descriptions)
scope: External intentionally-vulnerable corpus (Android-InsecureBankv2 master prebuilt APK). All findings are TP by design — 본 corpus 의 의도된 취약점을 본 파이프라인이 실제로 탐지했는지를 검증하는 표본.

labels.notes: Hardcoded `http://` for login POST — canonical InsecureBankv2 vuln (insecure transport). MITM credential capture trivial.
Cleartext logging of username:password on successful login. Any READ_LOGS-holding app harvests credentials. Canonical InsecureBankv2 'Insecure Logging' vuln.
32-byte ASCII string used as AES-256 key. APK reverse → key → decrypt all stored ciphertexts. Canonical InsecureBankv2 'Hardcoded Crypto Key' vuln.
Fixed all-zero IV with AES-CBC — deterministic encryption, chosen-plaintext attacks. MASVS-CRYPTO-1 violation.

Exported broadcast receiver SMSes decrypted password to caller-supplied phone number. Direct credential exfiltration via untrusted broadcast extra. Canonical InsecureBankv2 'Vulnerable Broadcast Receiver' vuln.
TrackUserContentProvider exported without read/write permission — any installed app reads tracked logins. Privacy leak.

Receiver exported without `android:permission`. Severity raised (Stage 1 medium → true high) because the action `theBroadcast` triggers the credential-SMS flow above. Stage 1 alone called this medium — it's actually high once cross-class dataflow is considered.

Multiple post-login activities exported=true (PostLogin / DoTransfer / ViewStatement / ChangePassword). Bypass of login flow possible — known InsecureBankv2 design issue. Reported as a single grouped finding.
WebView JavaScriptEnabled=true on an exported activity. Combined with insecure HTTP load (statement endpoint), XSS / token-exfil sink. Confidence 0.7 was appropriate at Stage 1.
